Clara: Saw a P95 jump on hosted streaming after tonight's framer tweak. Host CPU spiked; traces point to repeated tokenization. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/ingress-streaming
Diego: Which tweak landed? small-write coalesce or the new "microframer"?
Clara: Microframer + tighter coalesce. Seems to push more tiny chunks (100-300B) into the tokenizer. KV prefix reuse dropped ~8% on those hosts.
Min: Can you paste a short pprof top?
Clara: pprof (20s):
```
pprof top
10.7% tokenizer::tokenize_partial
8.2% ingress::parse_chunk
6.1% grpc::writev_small
4.6% kvcache::miss_accounting
3.0% allocator::slab_alloc
```
Diego: That matches fragmentation causing re-tokenize + more kvcache misses. Quick options: bump ingress coalesce window, revert microframer for streaming routes, or add a tiny tokenizer prefix buffer. Fastest to validate?
Clara: I flipped microframer off on a canary + increased coalesce_max to 2K. T+12m: P95 down ~9%, kv reuse back to baseline, CPU lower.
OpsBot: @deploy-bot rolled back microframer on canary (job 2058123482) :white_check_mark:
Ivy: Action items: Clara run 1h A/B and upload full flamegraphs; Min add kernel-selection histograms for the canary window; Diego prototype prefix-buffer in tokenizer behind flag. Also add nightly microbench for 1-8 token streaming tails.
Clara: A/B started. Will drop artifacts here when done. End thread.
